summary: Fred A. Priewert, Director of the Iowa Conservation Commission, relayed that his agency's Planning Section reviewed the draft environmental statement and found it to be a complete and concise document addressing environmental, social, and economic issues. He also confirmed that copies of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle Report would be made available to the public for review at his office. His letter is largely neutral and complimentary, expressing appreciation for the opportunity to review the document.

statement.text:
FRED A. PRIEWERT, Director
300 Fourth Street, Des Moines, Iowa 50319
Phone: (area code 515) 281-5145
Mr. G. Douglas Hofe, Jr.
Director
Bureau of Outdoor Recreation
U. S. Department of the Interior
Washington, D.C. 20240
Dear Mr. Hofe:
Our Planning Section has just reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on public lands. They report this to be a complete and concise statement dealing not only with the environmental, but also social, and economic issues as well.
As you have requested, copies of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle Report will be made available to the public for review in this office.
We appreciate your cooperation in allowing us to review this document.
Sincerely,
Fred A. Priewert, Director Iowa Conservation Commission
FAP/SLB/sk
